subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
1.
______ is conducted to ensure that the various programmes, schemes, and
projects where large financial expenditure have been incurred are run
economically and are yielding results expected of them.
(A)  Propriety Audit
(B)  Audit against Rules and Orders
(C)  Performance Audit
(D)  Audit against Provision of funds
(2 Marks)

AUDITING AND ETHICS

35
